name: openhistory
author: Zach Tratar <955182+ztratar@users.noreply.github.com>
description: A private, local-first work timeline with daily rollups for macOS.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:native: npm run build:native:swift && npm run package:native:bridge
scripts.package:native:release: sh native/collector/scripts/package-release-app.sh host adhoc && sh native/bridge/build.sh host release
scripts.package:native:todesktop: sh native/collector/scripts/package-release-app.sh universal adhoc && sh native/bridge/build.sh universal release
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts && npm run test:inference-preservation && npm run test:native && npm run test:distribution
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:public && npm run build
scripts.desktop:verify: npm run build:electron && npm run package:native:release && npm run package:native:todesktop && node --import tsx scripts/verify-todesktop-spike.ts --native-bundle && node --import tsx scripts/test-todesktop-before-build.ts && node --import tsx scripts/test-todesktop-after-pack.ts
scripts.desktop:package:local: npm run build:electron && npm run package:native:todesktop && node --import tsx scripts/package-local-app.ts
scripts.desktop:dry-run: npm run build:electron && npm run package:native:todesktop && node tools/todesktop/node_modules/@todesktop/cli/dist/cli.js build --dry-run --files
scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/require-todesktop-credentials.cjs && npm run build:electron && npm run package:native:todesktop && node tools/todesktop/node_modules/@todesktop/cli/dist/cli.js build --ephemeral --follow-logs
